text: The milk is infused first, then the rice simmers slowly so its starch thickens the milk; the sugar goes in at the end because it would stop the rice softening. It thickens more as it cools. Amounts are the Asturian recipe from asturias.com; the quick ratio is from a search-result summary of other recipes, not an opened page.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: 200 g round (bomba) rice in 200 ml water with salt.

steps.name: infuse
steps.note: Peel of 1 lemon and 1 cinnamon stick in the hot milk.
Over very low heat, with more milk added after about 30 min.

steps.name: burn
steps.note: 100 g sugar with 10 g cinnamon on top, torched (Asturian style).
